subject.title: fix(memory-core): use longer backoff for 429 rate-limit embedding errors (#108893)

question: Should memory indexing wait up to roughly three minutes for repeated provider 429/quota errors before surfacing failure?
rationale: The implementation is bounded and proven, but choosing this user-visible availability/latency budget is product policy rather than a mechanical correctness question.

options.title: Accept the bounded cooldown
options.body: Merge the separate five-attempt rate-limit schedule while preserving the existing short transport-error retries.

options.title: Request a shorter policy
options.body: Ask for a lower cap or fewer rate-limit retries if three minutes is too long for a foreground memory-index operation.

recommendation.title: Accept the bounded cooldown
recommendation.body: Merge the separate five-attempt rate-limit schedule while preserving the existing short transport-error retries.
